name: Mother of the Year
source:
Being a single mom isn't easy, but when your daughter gets the chance to attend an elite private school, you move to a new town and make it work...

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Mother_of_the_Year]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当单亲妈妈并不容易，但当女儿获得进入精英私立学校的机会时，你还是搬到了一个新小镇，努力让生活走上正轨…

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Mother_of_the_Year]Choices Wikia[/url]]
